title: Easy Shattering Mexican Beef Birria
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring tender beef, dill, and dashi-extract, with anti-inflammatory properties, served as a flavorful birria.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dashi-extract, tomato paste, beef broth, oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Shred the beef with two forks and serve the birria hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
